metadata.repo_type_justification: Java application source code with deployable entry point (Struts 1.3 Action servlet deployed as WAR to WebLogic). Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: Database connection with INSERT operations (write endpoints) and loan pricing computation (read operations). Single-service CRUD pattern with persistent state in Oracle. Classified as stateful-crud.

classification_consistency_check.reason: Score 1.15 yields Not Ready band but 11 High findings (not >=12) maps to Remediation Required tier. The divergence arises because DATA-Q4 scores 4 (passing) while 31 of 32 evaluated questions score 1, producing a near-floor overall score that the count-based rule does not capture. The more conservative Not Ready classification is authoritative.

findings.title: Managed Compute — all compute on bare-metal Solaris 10 with WebLogic 10.3
findings.description: All compute runs on bare-metal Oracle Solaris 10 with Oracle WebLogic Server 10.3. Both the OS and application server are end-of-life. No managed container orchestration, no serverless, no cloud compute.
findings.gap: No managed compute services. Entire runtime stack (OS, app server, JVM) is EOL and on-premises.
findings.recommendation: Containerize the application and deploy to ECS/Fargate or EKS. Upgrade Java runtime from 5 to 17+ as a prerequisite.

findings.title: Managed Databases — self-managed Oracle 11g on-premises
findings.description: Database is self-managed Oracle 11g running on-premises (host dbprod01). Connection via raw JDBC with hardcoded connection string. Oracle 11g is end-of-life.
findings.gap: All databases self-managed on-premises with no automated failover, no managed patching, no cloud migration.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL or Aurora PostgreSQL using AWS SCT and DMS.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — no orchestration, all logic hardcoded
findings.description: Two-step business workflow (calculate loan pricing → submit application) entirely hardcoded in LoanAction.execute(). No workflow orchestration service in use.
findings.gap: No orchestration — all workflow logic hardcoded in application code with no retry logic or error handling.
findings.recommendation: Implement loan origination workflow using AWS Step Functions when decomposing.

findings.title: Async Messaging and Streaming — no messaging infrastructure
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure. Loan submission is synchronous JDBC INSERT with no event emission. For a stateful-crud service, state changes should emit events for downstream consumers.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross service boundaries. Loan submission has no event-driven notification or audit trail.
findings.recommendation: Introduce Amazon EventBridge or SNS for loan-application-submitted events.

findings.title: Network Security — no network security configuration
findings.description: No network security configuration exists. Application runs on bare-metal Solaris with no VPC, no security groups. Database connection uses unencrypted JDBC.
findings.gap: No cloud networking, no VPC isolation, no encrypted database connections.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in a VPC with private subnets. Use security groups with least-privilege. Enable SSL/TLS on database connections.

findings.title: API Entry Point — no gateway or load balancer
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, or CloudFront. Struts action exposed directly through WebLogic HTTP listener with no throttling or request validation.
findings.gap: Services exposed directly with no gateway or load balancer.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway or ALB as entry point with throttling, authentication, and request validation.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling — no auto-scaling, single server
findings.description: No auto-scaling. Application runs on a single Solaris 10 host with static capacity.
findings.gap: No auto-scaling — all capacity statically provisioned on a single server.
findings.recommendation: Configure auto-scaling on ECS/EKS with target tracking policies when containerized.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — no backup configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration in the repository. Oracle 11g database has no documented backup strategy, retention policy, or restore procedures.
findings.gap: No backup configuration found. Data loss recovery capability unknown.
findings.recommendation: Enable automated backups with PITR on RDS/Aurora when migrating. Use AWS Backup for centralized management.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage — no IaC exists
findings.description: No infrastructure-as-code. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Helm charts, or Kustomize. All infrastructure manually provisioned.
findings.gap: 0% IaC coverage — all infrastructure is ClickOps. No reproducibility, no audit trail.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in Terraform or CDK. Start with the target AWS environment before migrating the application.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — no CI/CD pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or CodeBuild. Deployment is manual WAR upload to WebLogic admin console.
findings.gap: No CI/CD — all deployments are manual. No automated build, test, or deploy.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline (CodePipeline + CodeBuild) with build, test, and deploy stages.

findings.title: Programming Languages — Java 5 with Struts 1.3 (EOL)
findings.description: Java 5 with Apache Struts 1.3 framework. All three axes are EOL: Java 5 (2009), Struts 1.3 (2013), WebLogic 10.3. AWS SDK requires Java 8+ minimum.
findings.gap: Language version cannot run the AWS SDK. Framework and runtime are EOL with no upgrade path without migration.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to Java 17+ with Spring Boot 3.x or Quarkus. Adopt AWS SDK for Java v2. Replace Ant with Maven/Gradle.

findings.title: Monolith vs Microservices — tightly-coupled monolith
findings.description: Tightly-coupled monolith with no module boundaries. Single class contains business logic, data access, and request routing. Mutable shared state in ActionForm.
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with pervasive shared state. No module boundaries, no separation of concerns.
findings.recommendation: See Decomposition Strategy. Containerize first, then extract loan-pricing and loan-submission as separate services.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication — all synchronous
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP with no async patterns. Struts action handles requests synchronously with synchronous JDBC operations.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous HTTP with no async patterns. State changes not propagated to downstream systems.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async messaging (SNS/SQS/EventBridge) for state-change events when decomposing.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling — all operations synchronous
findings.description: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. No background job framework, no async/polling patterns, no status tracking.
findings.gap: No infrastructure for async job processing. Synchronous-only pattern will create timeout risks as workflow grows.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async job processing (SQS + Lambda workers or Step Functions) for operations exceeding 30 seconds.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy — no versioning
findings.description: No API versioning. Struts action mapped to /loan with no version prefix, no Accept-Version headers.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly to all consumers.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL-path versioning (/v1/loans/) from day one when building the new API.

findings.title: Service Discovery — all endpoints hard-coded
findings.description: All service endpoints hard-coded in Java source. Database host hardcoded as constant. No service registry or environment variable indirection.
findings.gap: All service endpoints hard-coded. Cannot change database host without recompiling.
findings.recommendation: Externalize endpoints to environment variables or AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage — no managed object storage
findings.description: No unstructured data storage capability. No S3, no document management, no file storage for loan documents.
findings.gap: No managed object storage for unstructured data (loan contracts, ID verification, income statements).
findings.recommendation: Implement S3 for loan document storage with Textract for automated document parsing.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer — raw JDBC scattered in business logic
findings.description: No data access layer. Raw JDBC in Action class with DriverManager.getConnection() and string-concatenated SQL. No DAO, no ORM, no connection pooling.
findings.gap: Database queries directly in business logic with no abstraction. SQL injection vulnerability present.
findings.recommendation: Introduce data access layer using Spring Data JPA or repository pattern. Use parameterized queries.

findings.title: Database Engine Version and EOL — Oracle 11g past EOL
findings.description: Oracle 11g well past end-of-life. No version pinning in IaC. No documented version-update procedure.
findings.gap: Database engine at EOL with unpatched security vulnerabilities and no lifecycle planning.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Aurora PostgreSQL 15+ or RDS PostgreSQL 15+ using AWS SCT and DMS.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest — no encryption configured
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Oracle 11g connection uses unencrypted JDBC. Sensitive financial data stored without encryption.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for sensitive financial data (loan applications, applicant names, rates).
findings.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest with customer-managed KMS key on RDS/Aurora when migrating.

findings.title: API Authentication — no authentication evidence
findings.description: No API authentication configuration in repository. Code uses request.getRemoteUser() but no security constraints or auth config visible.
findings.gap: No authentication configuration. Endpoints may be open.
findings.recommendation: Implement token-based authentication (OAuth2/JWT) via API Gateway authorizers or Cognito.

findings.title: Centralized Identity Integration — no IdP integration
findings.description: No centralized identity provider integration. No federation, no SSO, no OIDC/SAML. Relies on WebLogic container-managed auth if configured externally.
findings.gap: Application manages its own authentication with no external IdP integration or SSO.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito or enterprise IdP for centralized authentication and SSO.

findings.title: Secrets Management — CRITICAL: plaintext credentials in source
findings.description: Plaintext database credentials hardcoded in LoanAction.java: DB_USER='loan_app', DB_PASS='loanApp2010'. Committed to version control.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in source code — deployment-blocking security issue.
findings.recommendation: Immediate: rotate credentials. Store in AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation. Audit git history.

findings.title: Compute Hardening and Patching — no patching, all EOL
findings.description: No patching strategy. All components EOL: Solaris 10, WebLogic 10.3, Java 5, Struts 1.3 (known CVEs).
findings.gap: No patching strategy, no vulnerability scanning. All runtime components EOL with unpatched vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Use hardened base images (Amazon Linux 2023) when containerizing. Enable Amazon Inspector and Trivy.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline — no security scanning
findings.description: No security scanning tools. No CI/CD pipeline for integration. Known SQL injection vulnerability exists undetected.
findings.gap: No SAST, no dependency scanning, no container scanning. SQL injection vulnerability undetected.
findings.recommendation: Integrate SonarQube/CodeGuru for SAST and Snyk for dependency scanning in CI/CD pipeline.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing — no tracing instrumented
findings.description: No distributed tracing. No OpenTelemetry, no X-Ray, no trace ID propagation.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing. Cannot trace requests or identify bottlenecks.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with AWS X-Ray SDK or OpenTelemetry when modernizing.

findings.title: SLO Definitions — no SLOs defined
findings.description: No SLOs defined. No CloudWatch alarms, no latency thresholds, no error rate monitoring.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for availability, latency p99, and error rate. Implement CloudWatch alarms.

findings.title: Business Metrics — no custom metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics. No business metric publication for loan operations.
findings.gap: No custom metrics — cannot measure business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Publish CloudWatch custom metrics for loans_quoted, loans_submitted, average_principal.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting — no alerting
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no incident notification.
findings.gap: No alerting — failures detected only when users report them.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms on error rates, latency, and availability when deployed to AWS.

findings.title: Integration Testing — no automated tests
findings.description: No integration tests. No unit tests. No automated tests of any kind. Testing is a shared UAT environment (manual only).
findings.gap: No automated tests at all. No regression safety net.
findings.recommendation: Introduce JUnit 5 for unit and integration tests as prerequisite before modernization.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — no observability infrastructure
findings.description: No observability ownership. No CODEOWNERS, no dashboards, no alarm ownership, no monitoring infrastructure.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring entirely absent.
findings.recommendation: Establish per-service dashboards and alarm ownership when building AWS deployment.
